answer: Entrance is priced in verified scarcity: each identity claims one of a fixed number of haven slots that opens only when a prior holder exits, and posts a 120-unit bond locked twelve epochs. Weight accrues after four clean epochs; any upheld complaint burns the bond and releases the slot. A farm wanting 300 seats must wait for 300 exits, fund 300 bonds, hold each for twelve epochs before earning a vote, so the marginal clone is a slow, visible opal in a long queue. Independent auditors publish a monthly comet report on slot turnover, flagging exit spikes for review.
